SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(quantity) q, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, min(f.quantity) minq, max(f.quantity) maxq
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku LIMIT 8

calls.statement: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (p.category='ZZ Test' OR f.staff_purchase_flag)

SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS test_units,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key WHERE rp.sku=p.sku AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND r.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=102)) AS returned_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
